data.title: Passport appointment confirmation – Bürgeramt Musterstadt
data.summary: The Bürgeramt of the City of Musterstadt confirms an appointment for Mara Beispiel to apply for a passport (Reisepass) on 12 May 2026 at 09:30 at Bürgeramt Mitte, counter 4, with a fee of €70.00 due at the appointment.
data.explanation: This is a confirmation of a passport application appointment, not a bill or a legal decision. Go to the appointment on time and bring your current ID, a recent biometric passport photo, and €70 (card payment is possible). If you cannot make it, cancel the appointment online beforehand rather than simply not showing up. There is no deadline to respond to this letter otherwise.
